While in an invisible state, you deal massive damage to your enemy by spending a percentage of your total HP. You cannot use a recovery item for 10 seconds after the attack.

Your HP and Mana regeneration rate increases while not in combat. The regeneration rate bonus increases with training.
Increases the accuracy of Karma and allows it to ignore your opponent's defense by a set amount. Accuracy and defense ignored increases with training.

game_data.Description: Moderately increase your damage. The damage bonus and duration increases with training.
When a monster is infected with a parasite, the parasite and all other poisons will now spread to all nearby monsters. Transferred damage of infection increases with training.
Upon killing an enemy a percentage of the remaining damage dealt is passed to all nearby targets. Damage dealt increases with training.
Attacks an area with deadly force that has the potential to knock out enemies for a period of time.
Passively increases the health of all summoned creatures, and actively restores the health of any summoned demonic creature. Health restored increases with training.
Summons fire from the sky to inflict massive area damage, leaving fire walls in its wake. Damage increases with training.
Increases the amount of puppets summoned, and the area in which they appear. Amount summed increases with training.
Ignores all attacks except internal attacks for a certain period of time. The duration increases with training.
Sends a powerful energy through your weapon which cuts down enemies from a distance. Damage increases with training.
Lowers the targets attack power, movement and attack speed. When incapacited they will not be able to recover health. Duration of effect increases with training.
Augments Neutralize, When casting Neutralize it will now affect nearby targets. Amount of targets affected increases with training.
A skill that deals damage to enemies by releasing the energy within your weapon as you thrust it into the ground.
Cast a 7x7 spell of darkness that instills pain and fear in the enemy, continously damaging anyone in its radius. Duration and damage increases with training.
Deals a certain amount of soul damage, and depending on the target also temporarily prevents attack or movement. Damage dealt and effect duration increases with training.
Increases the probability of using your maximum defensive capabilities. Probability increases with training.
Permanently reduce all incoming physical attacks. Reduction amount increases with training.
Permanently reduce all incoming magic attacks. Reduction amount increases with training.
Use the full force of your swing to temporarily decrease your targets defensive abilities. Defensives reduces increases with training.

Throws a sword at the target inflicting damage. If the target is killed there is a chance to regain a percentage of your drained mana. Amount of swords thrown, damage dealt and mana regained increases with training.
Creates a massive area storm that continously damages anything in its radius. Damage increases with training.
Summon a tornado which damages anything in its path. The effects of the tornado increase with training.
Provides further HP regain to Celestial Light at level 3 or above, and acts as a shield giving the caster a small offensive and defensive bonus. Amount increases with training.
Enemies affected by shoulder dash becomes unconscious.
Throw a talisman at a dead target to explode their body and damage the surrounding area.
Reawake a corpse and command the dead. Requires a soul amulet.

Poisons targets hit by your swing, dealing a percentage of damage every 2 seconds for 10 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times. Chance to poison and damage dealt increases with training. Requires Poison Bottle.
Gain increased attack power when your targets health falls below 30%. Damage dealt increases with training.
Increases your physical resistance when your health falls below 30%. Resistance amount and probability to activate increases with training.
Throw a spear which burns away your targets mana. Applies only in PvP. Mana removed increases with training.
Increases your recovery rate when your health falls below 30%. Applies to all forms of recovery. Rate of recovery increases with training.
Chains your target to all nearby targets, preventing them from moving far apart from each other. Amount of targets which can be chained together and duration of chain increases with training.
Increases your crit chance for a period of time. Rate and duration increases with training.
Permanently increases the attack power of all dual weapon attacks. Power increases with training.
Uses your body's energy to avoid being poisoned, pushed back from enemy attacks, and any other harmful status effects.
Prevents targets in a large radius of the caster from moving for 3 seconds whilst dealing continuous damage. Number of targets affected increases with training.
Reduces the cost of Flame Splash. At level 3 or above it increases the amount of targets hit. Cost reduces further with training.
Continuously damages the enemy and prevents any health recovery. Damage and duration increases with training.
Create a trap on the floor from the fires of Hell. Lasts for 15 seconds and when stepped on deals damage in a 3x3 area. Damage dealt and amount of traps which can be placed increases with training.

All chained targets are slowed. At level 1 or above damage done to the leader will be dealt to all targets they're chained to. At level 2 or above continuous fire damage will be dealt to all targets. At level 3 or above will inflict damage in a 3x3 radius when the leader dies.
Returns a percentage of damage done to you back to the attacker.
You slow your enemy's movement speed and attack speed using your body's energy.
You become adept at using recovery items. You may recover more depending upon the level of your training.
Provides a wider area of attack for Destructive Surge at level 3 or above, and increases overall power. Damage dealt increases with training.
Improves Defiance by removing the need to reduce attack power. Duration increases even further with training.
Improves Reflect Damage by increasing reflect damage percentage and duration even further with training.
